tonight.headline: Barkley and Rice both left with hamstring injuries
body: Bad news first. Saquon Barkley hurt his right hamstring on his second carry and Rashee Rice pulled up with a non-contact left hamstring early in Las Vegas: two starters, 2.0 points between them. Garrett Wilson (5.7), Josh Downs (4.6) and Trevor Lawrence (11.1) all finished well under their numbers without being hurt. Carnell Tate had 21.5 and Ollie Gordon 18.0 on your bench. You trail 57.1 to 59.8 and ESPN projects 73 to 76, a 40% chance.

Nothing to do tonight. Darren Waller is your last player; Kamara plays Monday but every slot he could fill has locked. Team 13 are still starting two players who were ruled out, which is the only reason this is close. The moves are next week's: one conditional card below, and a tight end for Waller's bye on Tuesday.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Team 13 have Kyle Pitts (7.4) on Monday; McCaffrey (6.3), Kelce (3.5), Worthy (11.0) and the Seahawks D/ST (11) were in progress at the snapshot. DeVonta Smith and Rachaad White sat in their lineup at zero all day. Lamar Jackson, on their bench, left his game with an ankle injury.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Waller at or above his 10.1 tonight with McCaffrey held under his remaining projection. Nothing on your side can be changed to help it.

tonight.caseSources: ESPN league file · FOX Sports/AP · NBC Sports · BaltimoreRavens.com

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · when the week rolls, if Barkley is ruled out
doFirst.title: If Barkley is ruled out for London, start Tuten in his slot
doFirst.subtitle: A right hamstring on his second carry, no timeline, and Philadelphia's next game is overseas. Don't fire this until there's a ruling.

case.label: The injury
case.body: Hurt at the end of his second carry with 11:34 left in the first quarter and ruled out (FOX Sports/AP; Inquirer, 4 Oct). After the game he 'was able to walk perfectly normal' (Ashlyn Sullivan, NBC Sports Philadelphia, via Heavy). Nick Sirianni gave no update and there is no scan result. Week 5 is Jacksonville in London.

case.label: Why Tuten
case.body: He took 17 of Jacksonville's 23 backfield carries today, 74%, up from 60–65%, and had two rushing touchdowns called back for penalties (Jaguars.com). He plays in the same London game. Gordon scored more today, but that game wasn't final and Miami call it a split; Kamara is in a three-man committee.

case.label: The projection has the last word
case.body: ESPN hasn't published Week 5 numbers. If it puts Gordon or Kamara two or more above Tuten when it does, follow the projection, not this card.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Barkley practises in full by Friday and plays, in which case this never fires. If it fires: the back you start scores less than the best back left on your bench that week (archive).

doFirst.sources: FOX Sports/AP · Philadelphia Inquirer · Heavy · Jaguars.com · Week 4 archive

action.label: Start Tuten · bench Barkley (only if ruled out)

whatWentWrong.title: Barkley: a hamstring on his second carry
whatWentWrong.lead: He had no designation all week. 2.0 points, and it says nothing about him as a player.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: 2 carries for 8 and a 2-yard catch (archive), then ruled out. Tank Bigsby took 14 carries and was himself hurt in the fourth quarter; Will Shipley finished (RotoWire). The Eagles went 0-for-12 on third down without him.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The card above: Tuten is the named replacement if he's ruled out. It also makes Gordon's seat, the one the priority claim bought, more useful than it looked this morning.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A full practice from Barkley by Friday.

whatWentWrong.sources: FOX Sports/AP · Inquirer · RotoWire · Week 4 archive

whatWentWrong.title: Rice: a non-contact hamstring, with the bye next
whatWentWrong.lead: Doubtful to return today. Kansas City don't play in Week 5, so the injury costs today and nothing next week.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: He pulled up at the end of a short catch and went to the locker room; downgraded to doubtful to return (NBC Sports, 22:04 UTC). He was active with no pre-game listing. The league file shows 0 for him.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Week 5's lineup needed a replacement for him anyway: Rice and Waller are both on bye. Tate (12 targets today) and Golden (7) are the candidates for his slot, and next week's projection picks between them. It's the tight-end seat that needs a move, and that waits for Tuesday.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A report that the hamstring is a multi-week injury: then the question becomes Week 6 and beyond, and the receiver depth on your bench is already the answer.

worthALook.name: Mark Andrews
worthALook.lead: Waller is on bye in Week 5, so you need a tight end for one week. Andrews is the first name, and not tonight.

case.label: The role
case.body: 5 catches on 6 targets for 27 and a touchdown today: 13.7 (archive); 6, 7, 5, 6 targets over four games. Lamar Jackson left at half-time with an ankle injury and Tyler Huntley finished 8 of 9; Jackson's Week 5 status is unknown.

case.label: The number that kills it tonight
case.body: He played today, so he's on waivers until Wed 7 Oct, 01:00 Mexico City, and a claim would drop you from 8th to last for the season. After that, if nobody claims him, he's a free agent and costs nothing.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Tuesday's 16:00 brief decides: claim, or wait for him to clear and add him free on Wednesday. It also has to name the drop, and with Barkley and Rice hurt that isn't obvious tonight.

worthALook.name: Colston Loveland
worthALook.lead: The other bye-week tight end: nine targets today from a backup quarterback.

case.label: The role

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: On waivers until Wed 01:00, same as Andrews, and 91% rostered, so he is less likely to clear. You dropped him on 25 Sep when he was drawing 3 and 4 targets.

case.label: When to act
